evidence_limit: Earlier 873-test full-suite JUnit was ephemeral and is not claimed archived. No retained output directory was mounted writable into the test container. DIRECTED.junit.xml separately archives the bounded Phase C regressions. Historical 857-test JUnit remains versioned.
